name: Bollinger + RSI, Double Strategy (by ChartArt) v1.1
author: ChartArt
description_snippet: Uses the RSI indicator together with Bollinger Bands to sell when price is above the upper band and buy when below the lower band. Triggers only when both RSI and Bollinger are simultaneously overbought or oversold.

name: MACD + SMA 200 Strategy (by ChartArt)
author: ChartArt
description_snippet: Classic MACD combined with the SMA 200 as a strategy. Goes long if the MACD histogram and momentum are both above zero and the fast MACD moving average is above the slow one.

name: SuperTrend STRATEGY
author: KivancOzbilgic
description_snippet: Strategy version of the SuperTrend indicator. ATR based trailing stop; the ATR calculation method is configurable, default RMA with SMA as an alternative.

name: PMax Explorer STRATEGY & SCREENER
author: KivancOzbilgic
description_snippet: Profit Maximizer screens buy and sell signals (trend reversals) across 20 user defined tickers. Combines a moving average with ATR based trailing.

name: 3Commas Bot
author: Bjorgum
description_snippet: A strategy in a box for automating via third party API providers. Configurable entry and exit layers with alert plumbing for bot execution.

name: Hull Suite Strategy
author: DashTrader
description_snippet: The Hull moving average suite converted into a strategy for backtesting, with a configurable backtest window.

name: Buy&Sell Strategy depends on AO+Stoch+RSI+ATR
author: SerdarYILMAZ
description_snippet: Combines Awesome Oscillator, Stochastic, RSI and ATR. Author states it is for training purposes and should not be traded.

name: Ultimate Strategy Template
author: Daveatt
description_snippet: A template for converting an indicator into a strategy to obtain backtest statistics, with alert and risk management scaffolding.

name: Golden Cross, SMA 200 Moving Average Strategy
author: ChartArt
description_snippet: Goes long when the SMA 50 crosses above the SMA 200 and closes when it crosses back below. The classic golden cross.

name: Backtest single EMA cross
author: Che_Trader
description_snippet: Simple two EMA crossing strategy, long or short at the cross. Author warns of large drawdowns in choppy periods.

name: Flawless Victory Strategy - 15min BTC Machine Learning
author: Trebor_Namor
description_snippet: 15 minute Bitcoin long strategy built with a machine learning library on one year of history. Every parameter hyper optimised, per the author.

name: RSI Divergence Indicator strategy
author: eemani123
description_snippet: Based on RSI divergence. Long on bullish or hidden bullish divergence, exit when RSI exceeds 75 or a bearish condition appears.

name: Bjorgum Double Tap
author: Bjorgum
description_snippet: Pattern recognition for double tops and double bottoms, with entry signals, take profit and stop orders.

name: Fractal Breakout Strategy
author: ChartArt
description_snippet: Long only. Enters when price breaks above the last fractal top; uses the average of recent fractal tops for trend direction.

name: Price and Volume Breakout Buy Strategy
author: tradedots
description_snippet: Identifies buying opportunities by detecting concurrent price and volume breakouts over a range of candles. Aimed at high volatility assets.

name: Bollinger Band with RSI
author: lolnopls
description_snippet: Combines Bollinger Bands and RSI to predict volatility and entry points, triggering on closes that touch the lower band.

name: Scalping Support Resistance Strategy
author: HPotter
description_snippet: Draws a support line from the minimum average of high, low and close, and enters on the breakdown of that line.

name: 72s Strat: Backtesting Adaptive HMA+
author: io72signals
description_snippet: Backtesting harness for an adaptive Hull moving average, intended for exploring settings per pair and timeframe.

name: TrendMaster Pro 2.3 with Alerts
author: everget
description_snippet: Comprehensive trend analysis with risk management and session based trading controls.

name: Bollinger Bands Breakout Strategy
author: TradeChartist
description_snippet: Goes long when price closes above the upper Bollinger band and short when it closes below the lower band.

name: Price Divergence Strategy v1.0
author: JustUncleL
description_snippet: Trend trading using price divergence signals confirmed by a Donchian channel based oscillator.

name: Full strategy AllinOne with risk management MACD RSI PSAR ATR MA
author: SoftKill21
description_snippet: Combines ATR based take profit and stop levels with MACD, RSI, PSAR and moving average conditions.

name: Scalping with Williams %R, MACD, and SMA (1m)
author: girishmanuja
description_snippet: One minute scalping using Williams %R, MACD and SMA to generate buy and sell signals.

name: Simple RSI-MA Algo
author: Stable_Camel
description_snippet: Long/short algorithm using a fast SMA of RSI as buy signal and a slow SMA of RSI as sell signal, tested on a century of Dow data excluding costs.

name: Template Trailing Strategy (Backtester)
author: jason5480
description_snippet: A backtester orchestration framework for trailing stop strategies.

name: Trendline Breaks with Multi Fibonacci Supertrend
author: FibonacciFlux
description_snippet: Trendline breakout signals combined with a multi Fibonacci Supertrend for confluence.

name: EDMA Scalping Strategy
author: MightyZinger
description_snippet: Crossover of an exponentially deviating moving average with an EMA for entries and exits.

name: Grid Like Strategy
author: alexgrover
description_snippet: Progressive position sizing in the martingale family, doubling size after a loss to recover a losing streak.

name: Open Session Breakout Trader
author: RicardoSantos
description_snippet: Custom session breakout using a percentage of daily ATR to set breakout limits. Intraday only.

name: 3C QFL Mean reversal
author: Kveie
description_snippet: Identifies panic selling and buys below the base level, using safety orders in a DCA structure.

name: Moving Regression Band Breakout strategy
author: tbtkg
description_snippet: Goes long after a candle closes above the upper moving regression prediction band.

name: Bitcoin Scalping Strategy (PMARP + MADRID MA RIBBON)
author: CheatCode1
description_snippet: Combines the PMAR percentile and a moving average ribbon for Bitcoin entries.

name: Scalping with Bill Williams Alligator
author: 03.freeman
description_snippet: Alligator technique calculated on Heikin Ashi candles, applied to standard candles on 1 to 5 minute charts.

name: Camarilla Strategy H4 and L4 breakout
author: cristian.d
description_snippet: Camarilla pivot H4 and L4 breakout with trailing stop exits.

name: Extreme Scalping
author: 03.freeman
description_snippet: Buys when actual close is below a forecast close and sells when above, with very small take profit and stop distances.

name: Trend Surfers - Premium Breakout
author: TrendSurfersSignals
description_snippet: Trend following breakout strategy with entry, stop loss, position size and exit signal built in.

name: Stop loss and Take Profit in $$ example
author: adolgov
description_snippet: A simple exit example expressed in account currency, published for educational purposes.

name: Stepped trailing strategy example
author: adolgov
description_snippet: Stepped trailing exit with one stop and three take profit levels, moving the stop up as each level is reached.

name: Monthly Returns in PineScript Strategies
author: QuantNomad
description_snippet: Adds a monthly returns table to strategy output for additional performance analysis.

name: Ultimate Strategy Template (Advanced Edition)
author: Daveatt
description_snippet: Upgraded strategy template with real time stop and take profit exits and alert command text fields.
